children: This is the history subpage for the Mortar. It contains every revision of the tower's statistics.
Number is the damage dealt in the inner explosion sphere. Splash damage is decreased linearly if the enemy is in the outer explosion sphere.
Firerate does not account for projectile travel time.
DPS assumes only one enemy is hit and receives full splash damage. DPS does not account for projectile travel time.
Accounts for both normal and cluster bomb DPS.
